news.title: 7,000 Langflow servers are under attack. LangGraph and LangChain have the same holes
news.summary_raw: Your AI agent did exactly what it was designed to do. The framework underneath it just handed an attacker a shell on the box that holds your OpenAI key, your database credentials, and your CRM tokens.That is not a hypothetical. In a few months, three of the most widely deployed AI agent frameworks each turned a known, ordinary bug class into a way through. Check Point Research chained a SQL injection in LangGraph’s SQLite checkpointer to full remote code execution. Tenable and VulnCheck tracked
news.summary: 7,000 Langflow servers are under attack due to vulnerabilities in LangGraph and LangChain, allowing attackers to gain shell access and sensitive credentials. This highlights the risk of undetected security bugs in widely used AI agent frameworks.
news.enterprise_use: Check your AI framework implementations and ensure you're running the latest security patches to avoid potential breaches. Failing to do so may leave you exposed to attacks like the one described, compromising sensitive data like OpenAI keys, database credentials, and CRM tokens. Review your Cloudflare or CrowdStrike logs for any suspicious activity related to LangGraph or LangChain.
